sentence: And the market's reward for AI innovation splits along firm traits: return on assets improves a little, more for firms heavy on R&D, while firm value rises where sustainability metrics are good, with Democratic administrations amplifying the reward
passage: [Singh et al. (2026), abstract] "The study finds mixed evidence of a small positive impact of AI innovation on firms' return on assets, with the effect stronger for more R&D-intensive firms." / "The findings demonstrate that AI innovation increases firm value for companies that perform well on sustainability-related metrics. This effect is stronger under Democratic administrations than under Republican governments"

gemini.note: The sentence states the improvement in return on assets as a definitive fact, omitting the passage's caveat that there is only mixed evidence for this effect.
